name: Bar chart
description: Labelled bars from a table of label/value rows; changing values animates the bars.

params.name: rows
params.help: Up to 12 rows: label, value (a number)

params.name: unit
params.help: Shown after each value, e.g. % or k

params.name: max
params.help: Top of the scale (0: the largest value)
